positions.title: Co-founder, CTO
positions.description:
Designed and developed this online community in which college students write reviews and share their experiences with local businesses.
- Designed and implemented user interface.
- Built and maintained site backend on LAMP stack.
- Worked with small team to iterate on business model and quickly launch new features in response to user feedback.
- Helped to design and execute marketing campaigns to increase brand awareness and user base.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Worked with Dr. M. Brian Blake to organize, promote, and run the Web Services Challenge workshop at the 2008 IEEE Conference on E-Commerce Technology.
- Developed a tool for visualizing SOAP web service mash-ups.
